text_block_list.text:
On the way home from an outing with Mejiro Dober,
we spotted a poster of Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Ah. Isn't that McQueen's poster?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
You're right. That race the other day was great.
Just what you'd expect from a Mejiro Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Not really.
Just thinking you're right...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, I was just thinking...
"That's McQueen for you."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's not just the way she carries herself every day...
She's carrying so much more on her shoulders than I am, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's not just the way she carries herself every day...
She's carrying so much more on her shoulders than I am, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
A majestic aura backed up by real skill...
She really is the face of the Mejiro family, after all...
Just then, emerging from the bookstore across the street was—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: M-McQueen...?! What a coincidence bumping into you here...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
D-Dober!? Um... this has nothing to do
with the Yutaka special... errr...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Yutaka...?
Could you mean *that* Yutaka...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
!? The way you say that... Could it be
that you know Yutaka too, Dober?!

Bonding over the common topic of "Yutaka,"
the two hit it off... and decided to talk
at a family restaurant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course it is... Oh, right.
Did you already check out that new one from the other day?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Oh, right.
Did you see that new one from the other day yet?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes. I watched it live in real time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes. I watched it live in real time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're that type, McQueen.
Sorry, I'm the type to binge-watch them all at once.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, indeed, doing it that way
allows one to enjoy it much more thoroughly...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, watching it in real time carries
a certain suspense of its own, and that is quite enjoyable, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hmm... It's appealing, but the location is a problem...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Location...? Ah, if you mean in person, it certainly is quite a distance away...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, distance...?
Can't you buy magazines pretty much anywhere?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: A magazine...? No, I was talking about the ballpark...
choice_data_list: ...Aren't you two talking about completely different things?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh... You mean the mangaka Yutaka, right?
The one who made 'Burn Bright! Shibazaki Girls' Soccer Club'...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
You weren't talking about Yutaka the baseball player...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Sorry... I was just so happy
to finally talk about something we both like... I got carried away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "Me too... I thought we could share in the joy together... But to think you meant Yutaka-san, the manga artist..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Given how passionately Dober speaks about it,
they must surely draw some truly fascinating manga."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Fufu, let's take our time and talk about that, along with everything else, another day!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I never knew McQueen had a side like that... What a surprise.
choice_data_list: Everyone has so many different sides to them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
All kinds of sides, huh...
I suppose it really might be like that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I want to know more...
About all the different sides of McQueen...
choice_data_list: Why don't you lend her some manga?
How about we go watch a baseball game together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Still, I kinda wanna see it... a side of McQueen that I don't know yet...
choice_data_list: Why don't you lend her some manga?
How about we go watch a baseball game together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No, wouldn't that be a bit too pushy...?
choice_data_list: It seemed like you were interested, though?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Even if I do, wouldn't it come across as pushy?
choice_data_list: It seemed like you were interested, though?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's... what they said, but...
Well, I guess I'll ask just in case............

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
I'll hear them out, at least.
Later on, I spotted the two of them in the cafeteria, chatting away happily about something.
Later on, I spotted the two of them in the cafeteria, chatting away happily about something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No way...!
Are you telling me the fate of the girls' soccer team is put on hold until the next volume... genre?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ! ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah... A-Ahem.
That was a bit unladylike of me, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it... I was thinking the exact same
thing, so I was just surprised... or rather, really happy.

And thus, thanks to the manga artist Yutaka,
the two of them grew a little closer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Together, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed...
I have been curious about it... maybe I'll ask for one."

Later on, on our way back from watching
a baseball game together with Mejiro McQueen...

Later on, on our way back from watching
a baseball game together with Mejiro McQueen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, raising my voice like that...
How utterly embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"No, I get how you feel. That home run
was seriously so cool."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Precisely!
Even as the point gap widened, that swing was born from never giving up on victory...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You don't get to experience tension like that very often, do you...?
I guess I understand why McQueen is so obsessed with it...
Or rather, maybe I want to know more about it now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: In that case! Let's definitely go together again!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Let's go again...!
After that, they had a friendly walk back together, discussing the match with Mejiro McQueen along the way.
